data.comment:
# Comfy Vidu Q1- Start End to Video

Create smooth video transitions between defined start and end frames with natural motion interpolation and consistent visual quality. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_vidu_start_end_to_video.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: The shot starts with a close-up of the silver pupils of the robot character. There is a detailed facial expression performance. The character blinks and sheds tears. At the same time, the camera gradually pulls back to show the character's upper-body image. The background color transitions to light blue. The expression is vivid and meticulous, with real emotions. The teardrops slide down, and the transition is natural.
